Test certificates for the directory CA upload: `ca.crt` (a CA, PEM), `ca.cer` (the same, DER as Windows exports it)
and `dc.crt` (a server certificate the CA issued). `dc.key` is the test server's key, so a test can run an LDAPS server with `dc.crt`. `dc-weak.crt` with `dc-weak.key` is a server certificate with a 1024-bit key, as old domain controllers have. `other-ca.crt` is a second CA that did not issue `dc.crt`. The CAs' keys are not kept; none of these sign anything real.
